# Virtual-source / mirrored-space hypothesis: paint bg cells lying on straight diagonal lines through reflections of seeds.
# Build mirrored coordinates: reflect seeds across horizontal axis and vertical axis (and both), then for each virtual seed cast rays in 4 diag dirs through INFINITE space; map back via folding mod reflection periods.
def fold(v,H):
    while v<0 or v>=H: 
        v=-v if v<0 else 2*(H-1)-v
    return v
def solve(ii,limit=50):
    H_,W_=len(ii),len(ii[0]); cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in ii for v in row); seedv=min(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(H_) for c in range(W_) if ii[r][c]==seedv]
    marks=set(); V=[]
    # all foldings of seeds: (a,b) -> mirrors
    vr=[s if s<H_ else None for s,_ in seeds]
    V=[(s,r_) for s,(r_,c_) in enumerate(seeds) for r_ in [r_, -1-r_, 2*(H_-1)-r_]]
    vc=[(c,s) for _,(r_,c_) in enumerate(seeds) for c in [c, -1-c, 2*(W_-1)-c]]
    vset={(r,c) for r,c in [(rs,cs) for rs in V for cs in vc]}
    # cast diag rays from each virtual seed in infinite space
    seen=set()
    for vr,vc in vset:
        for dr0,dc0 in [(-1,-1),(-1,1),(1,-1),(1,1)]:
            r,c=vr,vc; step=0
            for _ in range(limit*max(H_,W_)):
                r+=dr0; c+=dc0; step+=1
                fr,fc=fold(r,H_),fold(c,W_)
                if ii[fr][fc]!=0: continue   # wall blocks
                marks.add((fr,fc))
    return marks

import numpy as np,collections
def info(n):
    i=np.array(allG[n+' input']); o=np.array(allG[n+' output'])
    cnt=collections.Counter(i.flatten())
    # dominant color = background
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # horizontal lines: rows that are nearly uniform
    hr=[];vc=[]
    for r in range(i.shape[0]):
        row=i[r]
        cc=collections.Counter(row.tolist())
        dom,n_=cc.most_common(1)[0]
        if n_>=row.size-2: hr.append((r,dom,[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=dom]))
    for c in range(i.shape[1]):
        col=i[:,c]
        cc=collections.Counter(col.tolist())
        dom,n_=cc.most_common(1)[0]
        if n_>=col.size-2: vc.append((c,dom,[r for r in range(col.size) if col[r]!=dom]))
    return i,o,bg,hr,vc
for n in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 7']:
    i,o,bg,hr,vc=info(n)
    print(n,'bg',bg)
    print('hlines:',[(r,d,a) for r,d,a in hr])
    print('vlines:',[(c,d,a) for c,d,a in vc])

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
